result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Customer may terminate on 30 days' written notice and receive a refund of prepaid fees attributable to the post-termination period, while Vendor has no convenience-termination right during a term. The existing term and Order Form provisions remain intact. However, adding a right to terminate “in whole or in part” goes beyond what the playbook expressly requires and creates ambiguity as to which prepaid fees are refundable upon a partial termination; the refund should be limited to fees allocable to the terminated Services.
